Your Genetic Wound
35.3
The Wound of Shame

Shame makes such people think they are unworthy of being happy and successful because others see them as «worthless» or condemn them for making mistakes. By trying to hurl themselves into work, they are proving their worth to themselves and those around them. When it comes to talking seriously about their mistakes, they make jokes or try to avoid the subject by all means.

Defensive Reaction:

In the repressive form, this Wound manifests itself as a desire to escape condemnation at all costs. In the reactive form, – as desire to shame other people and expose their shortcomings in every possible way.

Way of Healing:
Self-irony / Humour

Learn to laugh at yourself and not to take yourself and the mistakes you have made in life so seriously. Realise that the world around you and your life is the Creator's greatest joke! To do this, you just need to stay in your Wound, not run away from it. In fact, there is nothing to be ashamed of!

You do not have to understand these feelings. The important thing is just not to go away. To stay and be in it. Just let others see you «naked». Everyone is beautiful in all their manifestations! Everyone is valuable and necessary to the universe, with all their strengths and weaknesses. It is in the combination of all your manifestations that your uniqueness lies.

Emotional Reaction to the Manifestation of Wound
53.4
Anger

It is important to look consciously at your own behaviour. Are you not pushing others away? How does this pattern manifest itself? Remember that anger is just the flip side of kindness.

At low frequencies, it manifests itself as a Shadow: Anger. Anger is a manifestation of fear of rejection and low self-esteem, it is a way of pushing the other person away before they reject you first. Anger can manifest itself both overtly and covertly, "behind a person's back". Often these people do not show their pain openly and their anger gets stuck inside.

At high frequencies, it turns into a Gift: Kindness. It's all about evaluating and perceiving yourself. If you are confident in yourself and love yourself, you will feel the same way towards others. Such people have an innate gift for socialisation. If your Emotional Response is defined by the fourth line, see this Gene Key and its Gift as a quality you can bestow on others in relationships.

Practical Guidelines for Working through Wound

Ask yourself the questions: Why are you afraid of being condemned? How do your past failures hinder your future success? You need to accept your vulnerability and find in your depths a compassionate, sincere humour about yourself and everything that is going on. When the Wound of Shame is transformed, you will be able to discover your talent as a successful entrepreneur and businessman.
